topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I've just found out they're turning the building into condos. Everything is changing, so quickly. The walls that felt like home might belong to someone else soon. I didn’t expect this. I guess I’ll have to sort through all my things, decide what stays and what goes. It’s a lot to think about. Maybe I’ll take a walk, clear my head. The neighborhood seems different already, somehow. I’ll figure it out, make a plan. It just feels like there’s so much to do, and I'm not sure where to begin.
